examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.arabic: دفعت الباب الزجاجي الثقيل وخرجت بسعادة مع الاكياس الجديدة
examples.english: I pushed the heavy glass door and left happily with the new bags.
examples.transliteration: dafatu al bab al zujaji al thaqil wa kharajtu bi saada maa al akyas al jadida

examples.english: The door is locked and he does not find the key.

examples.arabic: فجاة ارى صديقي القديم احمد قرب الباب الكبير
examples.english: Suddenly I see my old friend Ahmad near the big door.
examples.transliteration: faja'a ara sadiqi al-qadim Ahmad qurba al-bab al-kabir.

examples.english: My grandfather opens the door with a big smile.
examples.transliteration: yaftahu jaddi al bab bibtisama kabira
examples.storyTitle: A Visit to My Grandfather's House

examples.english: I knocked on the door and she said welcome.
examples.transliteration: Taraqtu al-baba wa qalat hiya ahlan.
